trigger: a current incumbent group is compared sequentially with the next group and replaced only when a significance/rank rule fires.
risk: winner can depend on arbitrary group ordering, nontransitive comparisons and insignificant ties; it is not an order-invariant global optimum procedure.
gate: Use order-invariant global ranking/optimization or all relevant corrected pairwise contrasts; test output under permuted group order and retain statistically indistinguishable co-optima.
